== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Scanning Crew (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Scanning Crew]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-scanning-crew/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_Scanning_Crew.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>9578c39fade65f03f433468bb1d47a91a50ef72753d303f2fa1e0f868e3f407b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
